latest.description: This article covers a side project I worked on this summer while I was a Solutions Architect Intern with AWS. I developed an application to track storms in realtime across the continental United States, enabling analysis of tornadic thunderstorms and machine learning models.

latest.title: Scan user uploaded files using AWS Lambda MicroVM and ClamAV
latest.description: AWS Lambda MicroVMs are isolated serverless compute environments that provide vm-level isolation. In this post, I discuss a scenario where user uploaded files can be scanned for malware using MicroVM and ClamAV an open-source antivirus engine.

trending.title: Authenticate to AWS CLI Using aws login Without IAM Access Keys
trending.description: Learn how to authenticate to AWS CLI securely using aws login without creating or managing IAM Access Keys. This guide covers browser-based authentication, temporary credentials, setup steps, troubleshooting common issues, and AWS security best practices.

trending.title: Inside AWS Builder Center, where a global technical platform becomes a place to learn, contribute, and belong
trending.description: AWS Builder Center is amazing because it combines discovery with participation. A visitor can read, learn, build, connect, suggest, publish, and support. Each action adds something to the experience of the next visitor. The platform's resources provide practical value, but the community gives them atmosphere. Weekend Challenge adds creative energy. User groups add local friendship. Technical teams add depth and confidence. The gift store and AWS Builder Jacket make recognition tangible.

trending.title: Get Started with GPT-5.6 on Amazon Bedrock in 15 Minutes
trending.description: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 (Sol / Terra / Luna) is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock. This walkthrough takes you from zero to running in six steps: set up, first call, compare all three tiers, sweep all six reasoning effort levels, cut the cost of repeated input to a tenth with prompt caching, and finally let the model call a real MCP tool. It all runs through your own AWS account with no OpenAI API key. Every command is copy-pasteable and every number is measured, not estimated.

trending.title: Understanding Amazon Web Services (AWS)
trending.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a cloud computing platform developed by Amazon that provides a wide range of on-demand services, including computing power, storage, databases, networking, and security. It enables individuals and organisations to build, manage, and scale applications without investing in expensive physical infrastructure. AWS is widely used because it is reliable, secure, flexible, and cost-effective, making it one of the most popular cloud platforms in the world.
